reviews.title: Buggy
reviews.text: The first document was fine. Then I tried to import an RTF. It wouldn’t allow me to import it. It just was grayed out. Then when I went to import, the screen went blank. I tried deleting the app, reinstalling the app, etc. and it just every time would give me a blank screen when I try to import. I closed all the other apps that I was running in case it was a memory issue and it still did the same thing. It just seems like it should be more resilient than that especially coming out of the chute.

reviews.title: Charging a $60 subscription for features that use to be free
reviews.text: This tool has been my go-to for teleprompter work for years. Never any hiccup or fuss. I haven’t needed it for several months, and here I am on shoot day and I can’t mirror my text without a $60 annual subscription, or $115 to buy it outright. It’s been a great app, I’d spend a few bucks to own it, but any support I’d offer the developers is out the window with their price structure and hiding essential features behind a STEEP subscription that use to be free.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Disappointed. I thought that if you say it is free, one would expect to use the basic function. However, if you want to mirror the text in order to read it with the teleprompter you have to pay to upgrade. I have found another app, it is awkward but no upgrade needed

reviews.title: No monthly option

reviews.title: UI needs help
reviews.text: For the recording portion, app treats it too secondary. It’s not clear whether the app is recording or not, the timers ticking off don’t make intuitive sense, the recording timer changes from red to yellow, it makes zero sense. The only indication something is recording is the recording button changes its inside from a circle to a rounded square, it should be screaming RECORDING instead. Have a pulsating red or something that’s obviously recording. After failing to capture footage so many times, it’s easy to get fed up with the app when it cannot perform a very simple function.

reviews.title: Free uploads go away…
reviews.text: This app used to work extremely well, but the apps only stopped allowing me to import or update scripts. I’ve only created about four scripts and I cannot find anything online explaining a limit on the number of Scripps characters are importance included with the free plan in fact, the basic plan specifically says it includes unlimited scripts now the app is effectively forcing me to upgrade to a pro without explaining what limit I supposedly reached. I would consider paying for the full upgrade if the restrictions were clearly disclosed but cutting off functionality without any warning or explanation is unacceptable. because of misleading plan description and lack of customer service and transparency. I am moving to another Teleprompter app one star.

reviews.title: Sudden Change
reviews.text: It is not that I do not like this app, and I understand from a financial standpoint why the change was made. However, the change to invert the text was made suddenly and without notice a month ago. I know the app developers said that this has always been how this app functioned, but I know for a fact that that is not true. As an educator I relied on this app in order to produce our school’s daily announcements. Though I would like to be able to pay for this app there is no easy way for an invoice to be created through the apple App Store and if I requested reimbursement I would be denied because of the hoops we have to go through with our legal office. This leaves me in a hard place, as I would have to pay yearly for this app yearly out of pocket on a teacher’s salary.

reviews.title: Most annoying piece of software ever
reviews.text:
This telephone changes all of your text as you write, there is no way to turn off the annoying text replacement options, when you go to the menu edit options you cannot keep check spelling while typing or check grammar with spelling or correct spelling auto amount of time they just automatically come back and then turn your script into nonsense.

It is also really difficult to change the colour or background of the text, you almost always have to highlight the area want to change twice because it never works the first time. 

It does play your script but if you ever need to make any changes to then it is totally unreliable. I bought the pro version and it's a waste of money. The AI tools embedded into this are awful and intrusive. It needs so many fixes.
